method: Final-model recipe of E8 retrained on 100% of the labelled data (no held-out split); scored on Kaggle only
explanation: No validation score by design. Kaggle public 0.97833 vs 0.97408 for E8 (identical recipe on 80% of the data): +0.43 pts from 25% more training data. Predictions agree with E8 on 98.2% of test images; predicted class distribution matches training. 1h40 training on Apple M4.
preprocessing: Alpha-composite on white background, then resize to 224 x 224 (bicubic), ImageNet normalisation
preprocessing_why: Same as E10a: 25% more training data with the best validated recipe (E8).
